io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.player

Class PlayerProfile

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.player.PlayerProfile

  • public class PlayerProfile
extends java.lang.Object
    A class that can store a Player's Research progress for caching purposes. It also holds the backpacks of a Player.
    See Also:
    Research, Waypoint, PlayerBackpack, HashedArmorpiece
